connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.e18e.dev over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package mcp. No credential is declared, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace dev.e18e. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.
